_note: The monthly theme for both home pages. home.js and northstar-home.js fetch this at load and merge it over their built-in defaults; if the fetch fails they keep those defaults, so a bad edit here can never take a home page down. Changing the month is an edit to this file alone.

home.label: This month’s theme
home.title: Masking
home.body: Showing a version of yourself that feels safer than the real one — in a message, on a first date, in a room full of people. What it protects, what it costs, and how you decide when to let it down.
home.novaAsk: Is it okay to mask when I’m meeting someone new?

northstar.label: This month’s theme
northstar.title: Masking
northstar.body: Masking is when you hide parts of yourself so that other people are more comfortable. Most people do it sometimes. It can keep you safe. It can also be tiring. This month our articles are about choosing when to show more of yourself, and when not to.
northstar.novaAsk: Is it okay to mask when I’m meeting someone new?
